name: playground_code_job_template
rubric: Approve only if THIS task's own acceptance criteria in the plan are met and the pytest gate is green. Do not request features the plan assigns to a later task, and do not request a mechanism the plan did not choose.
taskInstructionTemplate: Implement Task {id} ({title}) EXACTLY, test-first, per the plan (briefRef). Implement ONLY Task {id}. If it is already implemented and its tests pass, make NO changes.
_note: Template for a coding job in this hub. Copy it per project. As shipped it points at the implanted memory layer (artifacts scripts/memorylib + gate pytest tests/memory) so -Preflight and -DryRun work out of the box. For a real project: set briefRef to your plan under workspaces/, repoint artifacts + gate.checks[].path at that project, list real tasks, then Preflight -> DryRun -> run.
